findings.title: Stale legacy bin can shadow new install
findings.problem: When the legacy override ($HOME/.codemie/npm-prefix) is migrated and auto mode resolves to npm-global, the installer never checks or reports $LEGACY_PREFIX/bin on PATH. The old codemie binary there stays reachable; the Windows branch removes its shims and PATH entry, the POSIX branch does nothing equivalent.
findings.impact: If the legacy bin precedes npm's global bin on PATH, users keep running the stale copy after reinstall, undermining AC6 on macOS/Linux. Reachability depends on the user's shell-profile PATH order and was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: After migration, when the resolved mode is not user-prefix and ":$PATH:" contains ":$LEGACY_PREFIX/bin:", print a status telling the user to remove $LEGACY_PREFIX/bin from their shell profile (the installer never wrote that entry, so guidance is the right fix).

findings.title: Resolve-InstallMode crashes on empty npm output
findings.problem: Resolve-InstallMode calls .ToString() on the first line of `npm config get prefix` with no null check, unlike the guarded $UserPrefixRaw handling a few lines later. With $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop', empty npm stdout throws a null-method error.
findings.impact: The default auto mode aborts the installer instead of falling back to portable. The trigger (npm printing nothing to stdout) is uncommon; reachability was unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Guard the value: `$raw = ... | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $raw -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw.ToString())) { return 'portable' }` before Test-DirWritable.

findings.title: DryRun misreports legacy prefix migration
findings.problem: Spec requires every new mutation to be visible under -DryRun. Invoke-Checked skips the `npm config delete prefix` under -DryRun, but the following Write-Status 'ran: npm config delete prefix --location user' prints unconditionally. Resolve-InstallMode then reads the still-set legacy prefix, which is writable, so dry run reports npm-global where a real run may resolve portable, and Test-DirWritable writes a probe file during the dry run.
findings.impact: Spec requirement is only partially met: -DryRun output claims a deletion that did not happen and previews a different mode and cleanup path than the real run, so users cannot trust the preview.
findings.recommendation: Under -DryRun print 'DRY RUN: would run npm config delete prefix --location user' instead of 'ran:', and state that the resolved mode is computed as if the override were deleted (or resolve against the default prefix, e.g. `npm config get prefix --location global`), so the dry-run preview matches the real run.

findings.title: Update fallback omits derived --prefix
findings.problem: installGlobal now targets the running copy via getSelfPrefixArgs, but the failure branch of updateCli still prints a hard-coded `npm install -g @codemieai/code@<ver>` with no --prefix.
findings.impact: For a user whose running copy lives outside npm's global prefix (the legacy/portable case this change exists for), following the printed fallback installs a second copy into the default prefix, or fails on an unwritable one, while PATH keeps resolving the stale copy. Reached from auto-update and `codemie update`.
findings.recommendation: Build the fallback command from `await getSelfPrefixArgs(CLI_PACKAGE_NAME)` so it includes `--prefix <derived>` when applicable.

findings.title: Win32 layout match misfires on local installs
findings.problem: deriveSelfPrefix treats any `<dir>\node_modules\@codemieai\code` as a global install on win32. That also matches a project-local dependency or the npx cache (`...\_npx\<hash>\node_modules\@codemieai\code`), and cli-updater applies no global-install gate.
findings.impact: Self-update, uninstall and list would run `npm install -g --prefix <project or npx cache>`, writing global-layout shims into a project root or cache. Whether auto-update fires for these installs was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: On win32 require evidence of a global prefix before returning it, e.g. `existsSync(path.win32.join(prefix, 'codemie.cmd'))`, and return null otherwise.
